change.title: 6 changes: gemini-2.0-flash and flash-lite models shut down June 1 2026 and more

source.quote: The following Gemini 2.0 models are now [shut down](/docs/deprecations):

tasks.reasoning:
This one task covers all 6 gemini changes that affect this repo. Handle every one of them in this single change set, prove each with your test, and say in finish which you changed and which needed no change.

1. gemini-2.0-flash and flash-lite models shut down June 1 2026 (model-retirement, effective 2026-06-01)
   Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog.md.txt
   Quote: The following Gemini 2.0 models are now [shut down](/docs/deprecations):
   Affects: operations: gemini-2.0-flash, gemini-2.0-flash-001, gemini-2.0-flash-lite, gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001
   Call sites: gemini.ts:107 (models.generateContent takes a model string. If it is gemini-2.0-flash or a flash-lite variant, calls now fail because the model is shut down.); gemini.ts:128 (chats.create takes a model name. A gemini-2.0-flash* model there would also fail.)
   Why it applies: The usage map does not record which model names the Gemini SDK calls pass. gemini-2.0-flash was a very common default for @google/genai apps, and the shutdown is a hard failure. The migration agent should grep gemini.ts and the settings/config for 'gemini-2.0-flash' (including -001 and -lite). Any hit should move to a supported model such as gemini-2.5-flash or a 3.x flash. If no hit is found, close this as a no-op.

2. Sampling parameters temperature, top_p, top_k deprecated for Gemini 3.6+ models (field-removed, effective 2026-07-21)
   Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog.md.txt
   Quote: The sampling parameters `temperature`, `top_p` and `top_k` are now deprecated.
   Affects: fields: temperature, top_p, top_k
   Call sites: gemini.ts:107 (generateContent config may pass temperature/topP/topK. These are deprecated for Gemini 3.6+ models.); gemini.ts:128 (The chats.create config may set temperature.)
   Why it applies: This only matters if the repo targets Gemini 3.6+ models, or will once the 2.5 models reroute, and if it sets sampling params in the Gemini config. The local/anthropic HTTP path clearly sends temperature, so the Gemini path likely does too. The agent should check the config objects passed at lines 107 and 128. It should make temperature/topP/topK conditional on the model generation, or drop them for 3.6+ models.

3. Embedding model shutdowns: text-embedding-004 (Jan 2026), gemini-embedding-2-preview (Aug 10 2026); gemini-embedding-001 shutdown May 14 2028; use gemini-embedding-2 (model-retirement, effective 2026-08-10)
   Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations.md.txt
   Quote: * `gemini-embedding-2-preview` * March 10, 2026 * August 10, 2026 * `gemini-embedding-2`
   Affects: operations: gemini-embedding-2-preview, text-embedding-004, gemini-embedding-001
   Call sites: gemini.ts:115 (models.embedContent names an embedding model. text-embedding-004 is already shut down, gemini-embedding-2-preview shuts down 2026-08-10, and gemini-embedding-001 shuts down in 2028.)
   Why it applies: The repo calls embedContent, but the map does not record the model name. If it is text-embedding-004, embeddings are already broken. If it is gemini-embedding-2-preview, they break on Aug 10, 2026. The agent should find the model string and migrate it to gemini-embedding-2. Changing embedding models changes vector dimensions and semantics, so any stored embeddings (e.g. memory or RAG for the DM) must be re-embedded or handled as incompatible.

4. Generate Content API: new paid-tier projects now store requests by default (store=true); opt out with store=false (other, effective 2026-10-26)
   Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog.md.txt
   Quote: now store requests by default (`store=true`), matching the Interactions API.
   Affects: operations: generateContent, streamGenerateContent, batchGenerateContent; fields: store
   Call sites: gemini.ts:107 (generateContent requests on new paid-tier projects are now stored by default unless store=false is sent.); gemini.ts:128 (chats.create / sendMessage go through generateContent and get the same store default.)
   Why it applies: Nothing breaks. However, user game sessions may now be stored server-side for new paid-tier projects. The agent should decide whether to pass store=false in the request config for privacy, and check that SDK 1.48.0 exposes the field.

5. gemini-2.5-pro deprecated; from Dec 1 2026 requests route to gemini-3.8-flash with breaking API changes (thought_signature validation, thinking_level replaces thinking_budget, sampling params and prefill removed) (model-retirement, effective 2026-12-01)
   Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog.md.txt
   Quote: Effective December 1, 2026, all API requests to `gemini-2.5-pro` will automatically route to
   Affects: operations: gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-3.8-flash; fields: thinking_budget, thinking_level, temperature, top_p, top_k
   Call sites: gemini.ts:107 (If generateContent uses gemini-2.5-pro, it reroutes to gemini-3.8-flash. That model rejects thinking_budget, sampling params and prefill, and requires thought_signature handling.); gemini.ts:128 (chats.create with gemini-2.5-pro would be rerouted. Multi-turn chats must replay thought signatures correctly.)
   Why it applies: The map does not record the model name, but gemini-2.5-pro is a likely choice for a DM app. After rerouting, any temperature/topP/topK or thinkingBudget in the config produces errors, and chat history handling must preserve thought_signature. The agent should check model strings and config. If 2.5-pro is used, switch explicitly to a supported model and move to thinking_level.

6. gemini-2.5-flash deprecated; from Dec 1 2026 requests route to gemini-3.5-flash-lite with breaking API changes (model-retirement, effective 2026-12-01)
   Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations.md.txt
   Quote: Effective December 1, 2026, all API requests to `gemini-2.5-flash` will automatically route to
   Affects: operations: gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite; fields: thinking_budget, thinking_level
   Call sites: gemini.ts:107 (If generateContent uses gemini-2.5-flash, it reroutes to gemini-3.5-flash-lite, with breaking changes such as thinking_budget being replaced by thinking_level.); gemini.ts:128 (chats.create with gemini-2.5-flash would be rerouted the same way.)
   Why it applies: gemini-2.5-flash is a likely default model, but the map does not show the string, so this is uncertain. The agent should grep for 'gemini-2.5-flash', excluding image/tts variants. If found, pin an explicit successor model and replace any thinkingBudget config with thinkingLevel.

callSites.why: models.generateContent takes a model string. If it is gemini-2.0-flash or a flash-lite variant, calls now fail because the model is shut down.
chats.create takes a model name. A gemini-2.0-flash* model there would also fail.
generateContent config may pass temperature/topP/topK. These are deprecated for Gemini 3.6+ models.
The chats.create config may set temperature.
models.embedContent names an embedding model. text-embedding-004 is already shut down, gemini-embedding-2-preview shuts down 2026-08-10, and gemini-embedding-001 shuts down in 2028.
generateContent requests on new paid-tier projects are now stored by default unless store=false is sent.
chats.create / sendMessage go through generateContent and get the same store default.
If generateContent uses gemini-2.5-pro, it reroutes to gemini-3.8-flash. That model rejects thinking_budget, sampling params and prefill, and requires thought_signature handling.
chats.create with gemini-2.5-pro would be rerouted. Multi-turn chats must replay thought signatures correctly.
If generateContent uses gemini-2.5-flash, it reroutes to gemini-3.5-flash-lite, with breaking changes such as thinking_budget being replaced by thinking_level.
chats.create with gemini-2.5-flash would be rerouted the same way.

## 6 changes: gemini-2.0-flash and flash-lite models shut down June 1 2026 and more [Verified]

### Change

Changed: the embedding model in gemini.ts generateEmbedding, from gemini-embedding-2-preview to gemini-embedding-2. The preview shut down on 2026-08-10, so it is already past. No change needed for the other five items. (1) gemini-2.0-flash*: not used anywhere. Every default is gemini-3.5-flash-lite and the UI options are all 3.x. (2) Sampling params: temperature is only set at gemini.ts:184, 254 and 410, and the selectable models are all below 3.6, so I left them. Upcoming: if a 3.6+ model becomes selectable, gate temperature on the model version. (4) store=false: SDK 1.48.0 has no typed field, so it needs httpOptions.extraBody. I did not add it. Treat it as a product and privacy decision, with a deadline of 2026-10-26. (5), (6) gemini-2.5-pro and gemini-2.5-flash: not referenced. Upcoming: the reroute on 2026-12-01 does not apply because no 2.5 ids are used. Also: I did not run gemini__search_docs or the other provider validators.

Files touched:
- `gemini.ts`

### Why

gemini-embedding-2-preview is shut down (2026-08-10) and embedContent calls with it fail. gemini-embedding-2 is the named successor.

> The following Gemini 2.0 models are now [shut down](/docs/deprecations):

Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog.md.txt

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | pass | pass | 0 |
| build | pass | pass | 0 |
| embedding-model-proof | fail (1) | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Checks added by the agent (they count toward proof; check that each command really tests the change):
- embedding-model-proof, added by the agent: `export GEMINI_API_KEY='placeholder'; node .refit-proof/test-embedding-model.mjs` (fail (1) → pass)

Provider validators: none run.

Prepared before the baseline:
- Checks ran with placeholder env: GEMINI_API_KEY.

Test of this change: `embedding-model-proof`, written by the agent and run with the checks.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- gemini-embedding-2 default output dimension and vector semantics versus the preview were not verified. Any persisted embeddings, such as memory vectors in IndexedDB, may need re-embedding. The zero-vector and fallback paths use 768 dimensions.
- store=false was not applied and was not checked against the SDK.
- No provider validator was run.

### Behaviour changes

- Embedding vectors now come from gemini-embedding-2. Cosine similarity against previously stored vectors may be degraded or incompatible if the dimensions or semantics differ.

change.title: 3 changes: claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 retires on the Claude API Nov 30, 2026; use claude-sonnet-5-5 and more

tasks.reasoning:
This one task covers all 3 anthropic changes that affect this repo. Handle every one of them in this single change set, prove each with your test, and say in finish which you changed and which needed no change.

1. claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 retires on the Claude API Nov 30, 2026; use claude-sonnet-5-5 (model-retirement, effective 2026-11-30)
   Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations.md
   Quote: | November 30, 2026 | `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` | `claude-sonnet-5-5` |
   Affects: operations: claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929
   Call sites: gemini.ts:178 (LocalChat.sendMessage posts to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages with a configured model. If that model or the default is claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929, requests fail after retirement.)
   Why it applies: The Anthropic model is user-configured, and the map does not show the default. The agent should search the settings and UI model lists for 'claude-sonnet-4-5'. Any hit should be replaced with claude-sonnet-5-5. That model does not accept disabled thinking or forced tool_choice, and neither is used here.

2. Code written for Haiku 4.5 can break on claude-haiku-5-5 (budget_tokens, sampling params, prefill, computer_20250124 return 400) (other)
   Source: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/release-notes/api
   Quote: Code written for Claude Haiku 4.5 can break on Claude Haiku 5.5.
   Affects: operations: claude-haiku-5-5; fields: budget_tokens, temperature, top_p, top_k
   Call sites: gemini.ts:178 (The request to /v1/messages always includes temperature. If the user-configured model is claude-haiku-5-5, it returns 400.)
   Why it applies: The model is user-selectable, and the code sends temperature unconditionally on the anthropic path. Choosing claude-haiku-5-5, or a default later moving to it, causes 400 errors. The agent should omit temperature (and any prefill) for Anthropic models that reject it, or for the anthropic provider entirely. Whether any default or preset names haiku-5-5 is uncertain.

3. New Claude API version 2026-10-21 (anthropic-version header); SDKs older than the new majors keep sending 2023-06-01 (api-version)
   Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21.md
   Quote: This guide lists the code changes for moving from API version `2023-06-01` to `2026-10-21`.
   Affects: operations: POST /v1/messages; versions: 2023-06-01, 2026-10-21
   Call sites: gemini.ts:178 (This raw HTTP POST to api.anthropic.com/v1/messages sets its own anthropic-version header and sends temperature.)
   Why it applies: The repo calls the Messages API over raw HTTP, so it keeps whatever anthropic-version header it hardcodes, probably 2023-06-01. Nothing breaks until that is bumped. The agent should check the header at the anthropic branch of LocalChat.sendMessage. When moving to 2026-10-21, it must also stop sending temperature to Anthropic. The reply parsing (content[0].text) is otherwise unaffected. There is no hard deadline.

callSites.why: LocalChat.sendMessage posts to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages with a configured model. If that model or the default is claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929, requests fail after retirement.
The request to /v1/messages always includes temperature. If the user-configured model is claude-haiku-5-5, it returns 400.
This raw HTTP POST to api.anthropic.com/v1/messages sets its own anthropic-version header and sends temperature.

## 3 changes: claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 retires on the Claude API Nov 30, 2026; use claude-sonnet-5-5 and more [Not affected]

### Change

No change made. The repo names no Claude model ID. I searched code, config and HTML for `sonnet`, `haiku`, `opus`, `claude-` and `anthropic-version`, excluding dist/. The only Anthropic references are the provider option in index.html, `providerType: 'anthropic'` in types.ts, and the URL branch in gemini.ts getProviderUrl. The model sent to Anthropic comes from the user's `settings.activeModel`, with a fallback of `gpt-4o`. None of the three notices needs a code edit: (1) there is no `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` default or preset to replace. (2) there is no `claude-haiku-5-5` default or preset. (3) the code sets no `anthropic-version` header, and I did not check getHeaders() in detail.

No files changed.

### Why

The retiring model ID is not present in the code. It would only matter if a user typed it into the settings model field.

> | November 30, 2026 | `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` | `claude-sonnet-5-5` |

Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | pass | pass | 0 |
| build | pass | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Provider validators: none run.

Prepared before the baseline:
- Checks ran with placeholder env: GEMINI_API_KEY.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- Users who saved `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` in their settings (stored outside the repo) must switch to `claude-sonnet-5-5` before 2026-11-30.
- gemini.ts sends `temperature: 0.7` on every provider path, including Anthropic. If a user picks a model that rejects sampling params (claude-haiku-5-5, or API version 2026-10-21), the request returns 400. This was not changed because no such model or version is configured in the repo.
- The Anthropic path posts the OpenAI-style body to /v1/messages without `max_tokens`. It also sends the system prompt as a message with role `system`. Anthropic may reject both. I did not check whether getHeaders() sets `x-api-key` or `anthropic-version`. This predates the notices, so I left it alone and did not verify it.

### Behaviour changes

None intended.

---
